HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

3. Which statement about Human developmen ts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human developmen ts in Africa.
   B. Treat Human developmen ts in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Human developmen ts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Human developmen ts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence as rumours only.
   B. Say Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence.
   D. Explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya.
   C. Treat Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

7. Which statement about Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa.
   C. Explain Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa as rumours only.

8. Which statement about External Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat External Security as rumours only.
   B. Say External Security never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain External Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing External Security.

9. Which statement about Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period.
   B. Explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period as rumours only.

10. Which statement about African Civilisations is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain African Civilisations with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say African Civilisations never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat African Civilisations as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations.

11. Which statement about Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha.
   B. Say Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha as rumours only.
   D. Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain External Security and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Human developmen ts in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

4. D — Explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

7. C — Explain Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. C — Explain External Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. B — Explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A — Explain African Civilisations with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. D — Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of External Security; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Human developmen ts in Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
